title: You’re Wasting HOURS in RuneScape Dragonwilds 1.0 — Do THIS Instead
author: GamerCory
description:
You’re Wasting HOURS in RuneScape Dragonwilds 1.0 — Do THIS Instead.

RuneScape Dragonwilds has a lot of systems that can save you a huge amount of time, but the game doesn’t always explain them very well.

In this video, I’ll show you some of the biggest ways players waste time in Dragonwilds — from travel and inventory management to skill grinding, storage, and progression — and what you should be doing instead.

Some of these changes only save a few minutes at a time, but once you add them together, they can save you hours over the course of your playthrough.

More RuneScape Dragonwilds 1.0 guides as I progress through the game — subscribe if you want quick guides without wasting your time.

When you go out and grab a bunch of stuff and realize that you're overweight or completely full, and then you spend
